surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the alternating exposure of the substrate to metal precursors (La(thd)3 and Al(acac)3) and ozone (O3), with the surface sites being saturated by each precursor to ensure self-limiting growth. The La(thd)3 and Al(acac)3 precursors react with surface hydroxyl groups, and ozone is used to oxidize the surface, leading to the formation of LaAlO3.
